findings.text: reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:764 rewrites the promotion request through read_promotion plus _write_json without the runs._pointer_lock on promotion-request-<run_id> that the owner of that record takes at reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:397, so a request_promotion racing the raise stores a snapshot taken before this write and the coordinator's priority_override is silently absent from the record the drain ranks.

reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:648 charges a delivered run's raise to its queued review when one exists, and a review stops holding points the moment it launches (reckon/crew/runs.py:676 reads PRIORITY_HOLDING_PHASES at :592), so in that branch the points return at the review's launch rather than when the run lands or is discarded as section 3 states at docs/plans/a-session-spends-a-priority-budget.html:74; tests/test_a_run_s_priority_carries_to_its_review_and_its_promotion.py:163 measures the return only in the no-review branch, so the earlier return is unmeasured.

/home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261114T202123456216-sspb-a-run-s-priority-carries-to-its-review-and-its-p/manifest.md:15 states negative_control_log as two comma-joined paths, the first a truncated runs- directory and the second repair-control-baseline.log, which does not exist in the run directory; the red log the note describes is repair-negative-control.log, named in test_logs but not in this field, so a reader or gate taking the field at its word opens nothing, and :18's after_suite revision 93cbdf66fd2e612bafb95e8a2c8c9e296b54c is 38 hex characters against the log header's 93cbdf66fd2e612bafb95e8a2c8c9e296b41b54c, so it resolves to no commit.

VERDICT goal: the node's goal is that a run's priority carries to its review and its promotion, and the diff delivers it at reckon/crew/queue_order.py:326, where _precedence ranks two reviews by the points their own queued record carries, and at reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:587, where reprioritise accepts a delivered run and writes the points onto the run, onto its queued review at :748 and onto its queued promotion request at :761.
VERDICT done_when: section 3's three bullets are measured by tests/test_a_run_s_priority_carries_to_its_review_and_its_promotion.py, whose 7 tests cover review order, promotion drain order and the delivered-run charge; the manifest records scoped-gate-1794998924291726900.log at 7 passed in 0.60s with EXIT=0, and the base arm at s3-negative-control-base.log is 3 failed, 2 passed with EXIT=1 naming the review-order, delivered-charge and delivered-carry cases.
VERDICT write_paths: read the declared paths against git diff 8d870f62..93cbdf66fd; all 11 changed files lie inside them (reckon, tests, skills, docs/_shared/flight.schema.json and docs/evidence/fragments/a-session-spends-a-priority-budget), and the declared docs/figures path carries no file.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the 7-passed gate, the 2-failed repair control and 58 passed on each suite arm at its own revision, while its negative_control_log is two comma-joined paths (one truncated, one absent) and its after_suite revision is a truncated sha.
VERDICT diff: read all six commits a511935220, b9d2c8fe8f, b7884a4b93, b7dd46560d, 637e28986c and 93cbdf66fd against base 8d870f62: the charge and carry code plus its tests, the section evidence, the skill paragraph, the repair, and the schema description moved in step across all three generated surfaces.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3178, reckon/crew/runs.py:1130, reckon/crew/runs.py:1154, reckon/crew/queue_order.py:555, reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:727
SCORE goal_fidelity: 17
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/queue_order.py:326 orders two reviews by their points and reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:587 carries a delivered run's raise onto both queued records, though those points return earlier than docs/plans/a-session-spends-a-priority-budget.html:74 states.
SCORE evidence: 17
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the manifest records the gate at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261114T202123456216-sspb-a-run-s-priority-carries-to-its-review-and-its-p/scoped-gate-1794998924291726900.log as 7 passed with EXIT=0, both suite arms at 58 passed, and the red control at 2 failed with EXIT=1 in repair-negative-control.log.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in git diff 8d870f62..93cbdf66fd lies inside the declared write paths, and the schema description moves in step at reckon/schema/flight.yaml, reckon/_flight_schema.py and docs/_shared/flight.schema.json.
SCORE durability: 16
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_run_s_priority_carries_to_its_review_and_its_promotion.py:224 fails at 8 == 4 when the repair at reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:648 is reverted, as repair-negative-control.log records, and :105 fails on the base revision, but :139 and :129 guard behaviour the base revision already had and cannot redden on a regression in this change.
SCORE fit: 17
JUSTIFICATION fit: the change keeps the module's idiom of private helpers and deferred imports at reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:648 and names its own constants in reckon/crew/runs.py:609 (PRIORITY_DELIVERED_MARK) beside the phases it extends.
SCORE reuse: 18
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the ranking extends the single owner at reckon/crew/queue_order.py:247 (_override) and :326 (_precedence), the budget reader at reckon/crew/runs.py:651 is widened by a parameter rather than duplicated, and the review lookup reuses _resolved_reviewed_run_id at reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:694, with only the two pointer-field writes at :683 and :748 repeated rather than shared.
FINDING reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:764 non-blocking: the promotion request is rewritten without the lock its owner takes at reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:397, so a concurrent request_promotion can drop the raise with no error.
FINDING reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:648 non-blocking: with a queued review the raise is charged there, so its points return when the review launches (reckon/crew/runs.py:676) rather than when the run lands or is discarded as docs/plans/a-session-spends-a-priority-budget.html:74 states.
